name: pi-tool-display
notes: Forked from MasuRii/pi-tool-display. The bashCommandDisplay contract lives in openspec (spec bash-command-display); bashLivePreviewMode and bashOutputMode:'auto' are documented in the package README. The read-only tool presentation provider (getToolPresentation/presentationRevision on pi-tool-display.api.v1) is specified in openspec (spec transcript-builder-api, change align-btw-transcript-presentation) and documented for consumers in docs/tool-presentation-provider.md with types in tool-display-api-consumer.d.ts.
reapplyOnSync: the fork import block in src/bash-display.ts, where renderBashCall gains an optional config param, replaces upstream's new Text("", 0, 0) reuse expression with new BashCommandLineText("", 0, 0), and adds one resolveBashCommandDisplayArgs preprocessing line plus one text.setCollapse(shouldCollapseBashCommand(config, context)) line — buildBashCallText and its 3 call sites keep upstream bytes
the bash-auto-mode import plus its normalization call at the top of the fork-owned renderBashDisplayResult, and the 2 renderBashCall call sites passing the existing getConfig()
the types.ts / config-store.ts / config-modal.ts / presets.ts entries for bashOutputMode and bashCommandDisplay
the README mode/config rows, the live-preview paragraph, the 'Bash Command Line Display' section and example-config key, plus config/config.example.json
keep the kind:'bash' adapter and the renderBashDisplayResult extraction that let pi-sandbox's decorated bash tool render natively

the read-only presentation provider seams in src/tool-overrides.ts: the src/tool-presentation.ts import, the recordToolPresentation(pi, tool) call after a successful pi.registerTool in registerRuntimeTool, the attachToolPresentationApi(api, getConfig) call before the api.v1 global assignment, the bindToolPresentationOwner(pi, toolDisplayApi) call right after installToolDisplayApi, the localWorkspace guard at the top of resolvePendingDiffPreview, the executionMetadata gate around getWriteExecutionMeta in the write renderResult plus the same-branch content fallback that shows the real result text instead of an inferred empty-previous-file diff, and the disposeToolPresentationApi(toolDisplayApi) call in the registerToolDisplayOverrides cleanup
the optional getToolPresentation/presentationRevision members, the ToolPresentationSnapshot/render-context/display-capabilities types and the docs path reference in tool-display-api-consumer.d.ts
the docs/tool-presentation-provider.md entry in package.json files so the consumer contract ships in the tarball
keep the type-publishing build (rollup.dts.config.mjs, exports types -> dist/public.d.ts via prepack)
保留 fork 独立发布版本、CHANGELOG 发布条目与仓库 versions.json 的一致性；不要用 upstream 版本替换 fork 版本。
doNotReintroduce: do not re-add the fork-only formatEarlierLinesHint/buildTailPreviewText copies or the unreachable empty-lines branch: upstream's optional label and take:'head'|'tail' params cover both
